hints.title: Relative Sequence Invariance
hints.text: The relative order of non-X characters cannot change during valid swap operations.

hints.title: Directional Movement Constraints
hints.text: Characters L can only move leftward over X, and characters R can only move rightward over X.

hints.title: Index Comparison Invariants
hints.text: Pair up corresponding L and R characters ignoring blanks. Verify that every L in start has index greater than or equal to its index in end, and every R has index less than or equal to end.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Two pointer traversal skipping blank X characters and enforcing directional monotonicity.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Breadth-first search exploring all valid swap transitions incurs exponential state explosion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space O(1) using index pointers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Check non-X equality and ensure L moves only left (i >= j) and R moves only right (i <= j).
